text:
marta (runtime): Heads up — since ~1865432050 we've seen a ~3x token-latency spike on host-pool-a and a ~25% throughput drop. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.co/d/abcd/runtime-latency -> token_p50/95/99 all moved up but traces for many request_ids are missing in jaeger. Anyone near this?

ryan (oncall): grabbing oncall. Do we know which model_ids / routes are impacted?

marta (runtime): initial filter looks like mixed-seqlen traffic to rtx-7b variants (model_id=redwood/rtx-7b, rtx-7b-q4) — high variance in seq len. KV-cache eviction rate spiked too (see later). Host list: host-pool-a nodes 3/7 are hot.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: rollout start 1865432030 by vik. PR: https://git.redwood.co/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/718 (batching-heuristic-prefetch). Commits: 7c9a4f2 -> a19b3c5

ashwin (obs): looking at trace sampling — we see a big gap. Jaeger ingester logs show a flurry of dropped spans around 1865432060-1865432120. Sampling filter was recently changed in prod experiments.yml (sampling.key = model_id) but the experiment rollout was partial. If sampling key missed some tenants we get metrics without traces.

vik (infra): that rollout touched batch heuristics + prefetch router. My commit added a dynamic prefetch threshold to try to reduce tail latency for uniform seq lengths. Snippet from PR: 
```yaml
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  dynamic_threshold_percentile: 70
  min_tokens: 32
  max_tokens: 1024
```
I did not touch trace sampling.

linh (ml perf): KV cache eviction rate chart:
```
kv_evictions/sec{pool="host-pool-a"}  -> baseline 12  -> spike to 420 at 1865432065
kv_cache_hit_ratio{model=rtx-7b} -> dropped from 0.93 -> 0.56
```
This aligns with heavy mixed-seqlen workloads where tiny requests evict prefixes used by longer requests. That can force recompile/less-optimal kernel choices.

marta (runtime): I ran a quick perf profile on one node (flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood.co/fg/1865432068). Key takeaway: runtime-selector is frequently falling back to slow FP32 kernels mid-request after cache misses. Observed a lot of `kernel_change` events and `kv_rebuild` spikes.

ashwin (obs): The missing traces are because the new trace sampling experiment had a bug: the sampler hash used `model_id` but the ingestion path switched keys to `model_variant` earlier (rename in metrics refactor). So samples that hit the new ingestion path were filtered out. Example mismatch: metric tag `model_variant=rtx-7b-q4` vs sampler expecting `model_id=redwood/rtx-7b`.

vik (infra): ohhhhh. We rolled the batching change and also a metrics rename in the same window (ops/tree/metrics-rename). That explains dashboard mismatches — dashboards still query `model_id` tags.

ryan (oncall): action items to stabilize now?

marta (runtime): Immediate mitigation: revert prefetch dynamic threshold to previous static config (rolling back PR 7c9a4f2) on host-pool-a, scale up host-pool-a by +2 nodes for capacity, and set trace sampling to 100% for affected tenants for 30m.

vik (infra): I'll roll back the prefetch change on pool-a now. Rolling revert: a19b3c5 -> revert started. ETA ~90s. Also adding a quick flag to disable dynamic prefetch globally if needed.

deploy-bot: Revert deploy started for service=runtime on host-pool-a at 1865432130 by vik.

ashwin (obs): I'm bumping trace sampling to 100% for the impacted model_variant keys and adding a temporary shim to accept both `model_id` and `model_variant` for sampling decisions. Patch pushed to ops-experiments.

linh (ml perf): adding a new alert: kv_evictions/sec > 200 for >1m on any pool -> Pager. Also adding an SLO check for frequent kernel_change events (p99 kernel_count_per_req).

ryan (oncall): good. Any dashboard fixes?

marta (runtime): Will add metric aliases to dashboards and add a small runbook note: if token_p99 jumps with traces missing, check sampler key parity and recent metric renames.

vik (infra): Revert finished at 1865432148. Host metrics show latencies trending down on pool-a.

deploy-bot: Revert successful: deployment_id=deploy-1865432148, status=success

ashwin (obs): traces reappearing after sampler shim applied. I'm also increasing Jaeger ingestion debug logs for 10m to capture any further dropouts.

marta (runtime): TLDR & follow-ups:
- Root cause: interaction of dynamic prefetch batching + KV cache churn -> kernel fallback + higher eviction -> latency spike.
- Observability gap: trace sampling key mismatch (model_id vs model_variant) + simultaneous metrics rename meant traces were filtered and dashboards showed stale names.
- Immediate fixes: rollback prefetch change, increase capacity, force-sample affected traffic, shim sampler to accept both tags.
- Postmortem: ticket created -> TICKET-4923 (owners: marta, ashwin, vik, linh). Add tests to ensure sampling key parity on deploys and a dashboard that shows sampling/drop counts vs latency.

ryan (oncall): monitoring back to normal for now. Thanks all — follow-up in TICKET-4923. :thumbsup:
